content.title: Tipoff time, TV channel set for Iowa basketball vs. Illinois
content.text: The Final Four field is now set.The men’s NCAA tournament wrapped up the Elite Eight on Sunday night in incredible fashion, thanks to a wild comeback and game-winner from UConn to stun top-seeded Duke.AdvertisementThat sent the Huskies into their third Final Four over the past four seasons. The last two times they were there, they took home the national title.UConn will go up against Illinois first on Saturday night in Indianapolis. The Illini beat Iowa to end the Hawkeyes’ deep NCAA tournament run in their Elite Eight matchup on Saturday.The other side of the bracket features a national championship-caliber game in the semifinals. Arizona and Michigan will square off in the late game on Saturday after each side picked up a double-digit win in their respective Elite Eight contests.Here’s everything you need to know to keep up with the men’s Final Four on Saturday night.AdvertisementHow to watch, follow the men’s Final FourSaturday, April 4No. 3 Illinois vs. No. 2 UConnWhen: 6:09 p.m. ETTV: TBS, TNT and TruTVEarly BetMGM line: Illinois -2.5No. 1 Michigan vs. No. 1 ArizonaWhen: 8:49 p.m. ETTV: TBS, TNT and TruTVEarly BetMGM line: Michigan -1.5Monday, April 6National Championship GameWhen: 8:30 p.m. ETTV: TBS, TNT and TruTVWhere is the Final Four?The Final Four will take place at Lucas Oil Stadium, home of the NFL’s Indianapolis Colts, in Indiana.Who is calling the Final Four?Ian Eagle, Bill Raftery, Grant Hill and Tracy Wolfson will be on the call throughout the Final Four games this weekend.AdvertisementWhere will the Final Four be next year?The NCAA has announced Final Four sites through the 2031 tournament, all set for NFL stadiums throughout the country.2027: Ford Field | Detroit, Michigan2028: Allegiant Stadium | Las Vegas, Nevada2029: Lucas Oil Stadium | Indianapolis, Indiana2030: AT&T Stadium | Arlington, Texas2031: Mercedes-Benz Stadium | Atlanta, Georgia
